url.description: Required HTTP(S) JSON-RPC endpoint with a host; no embedded username/password. Loopback/private addresses are allowed, redirects disabled. Only contact a trusted endpoint. Raw mode cannot use configured headers; use managed tools for authentication/session handling.

method.description: Required JSON-RPC method, nonblank and at most 200 UTF-8 bytes (runtime check). Sent verbatim; may mutate remote state. No implicit MCP initialization or method allowlist.

params.description: JSON value sent verbatim as JSON-RPC params; defaults to {} when omitted. Not restricted to an object by this adapter; match the remote method's contract and avoid sending secrets unnecessarily.

id.description: Request correlation ID; defaults to integer 1. Runtime accepts strings or integers representable as signed/unsigned 64-bit values, not null/fractional numbers. Always sends a request, not a notification.

timeoutSeconds.description: HTTP request deadline in seconds, 1-300; default 60. Timeout/cancellation may occur after remote side effects; not a rollback.
